project: Realm Forge - Bug Fixes and UI Adjustments
description: Fix CSS disappearing bug, align toggle with resize handle, and make zoom buttons smaller

userStories.title: Fix CSS disappearing bug on page load
userStories.description: Critical bug: CSS appears on page load then disappears, causing borders and styles to vanish. Need to investigate and fix the root cause of CSS not persisting after initial render.
acceptanceCriteria: CSS persists correctly after page load
All styles (colors, spacing, typography) stay applied
Check for race conditions in style loading
All components render with correct styles
userStories.notes: This is a critical bug that needs immediate investigation

userStories.title: Align toggle button with resize handle
userStories.description: The toggle button should be aligned/stuck together with the resize handle on the right edge of the sidebar. Currently they may be at different vertical positions or not visually connected.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle button positioned adjacent to resize handle
Both buttons aligned on same vertical axis or visually grouped
Small gap (4-8px) between toggle and resize handle
Visual harmony between the two controls

userStories.title: Make zoom buttons smaller and more compact
userStories.description: The zoom control buttons are too large and take up too much space. Make them smaller and more compact while maintaining usability.
acceptanceCriteria: Zoom buttons reduced in size (smaller padding, smaller icons)
Still easy to click and use

userStories.title: Test and validate all fixes
userStories.description: Run quality gates and verify all bug fixes and UI adjustments work correctly
acceptanceCriteria: CSS persists correctly after page load
Toggle button aligned with resize handle
Zoom buttons are smaller and compact
